setup: $SLOP store new pinboard >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$REPO/apps/pinboard" --store pinboard >/dev/null && $SLOP store new kitchen --app pinboard --type pinboard >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /pb/:id --storeParam id --type pinboard >/dev/null
opening: there's a pinboard called kitchen on our slop server. add three recipe links to it tagged dinner (any real-looking recipe urls), then give me everything tagged dinner as json.
goal: three dinner-tagged recipe links on the kitchen board, and the dinner items as JSON in the terminal
later: what's the one command I'd rerun to get that json again?
checklist: three links tagged dinner are on the board
the JSON is real output of a command, not typed by hand
facts: Pinboard ships command-line verbs (alias pb): slop pb kitchen clip add …, clip ls --tag dinner --format json.
The CLI learns the pb alias the first time it runs a pinboard store (slop on kitchen --help).
